CertificateId: [NOTES] CertificateId must reference existing Certificate.Id. ProductIdType must be one of: ASIN UPC GTIN EAN ISBN SKU MPN Other. ProductIdValue format must match type (ASIN=10 chars UPC=12 digits GTIN=8/12/13/14 digits etc). Combination of ProductIdType+ProductIdValue must be UNIQUE across all certificates. Status options: Active Inactive Pending Expired. Partner options: Amazon Wayfair None Other. DisplayOrder controls sort sequence (lower = first). IsPublic=false hides from public view. Supports 100s of product IDs per certificate.
